name: Divaplon
summary: Divaplon (RU-32698) is a nonbenzodiazepine, anxiolytic and anticonvulsant drug from the imidazopyrimidine family of drugs. It acts as a partial agonist at the "benzodiazepine site" of the GABAA receptor in the brain.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a partial agonist at the "benzodiazepine site" of the GABAA receptor in the brain.

uses.en: It was developed as an anti-anxiety and anti-seizure drug but was never marketed. Today it is only of research interest.
uses.zh: 它原本被開發為抗焦慮與抗癲癇藥物，但從未上市。如今僅具研究價值。
uses.zhHans: 它原本被开发为抗焦虑与抗癫痫药物，但从未上市。如今仅具研究价值。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs that act at the benzodiazepine site can cause drowsiness, poor coordination and memory problems, and regular use can lead to dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的影響所知甚少。作用於苯二氮平位點的藥物可能造成嗜睡、協調不良與記憶問題，長期使用也可能產生依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的影响所知甚少。作用于苯二氮平位点的药物可能造成嗜睡、协调不良与记忆问题，长期使用也可能产生依赖。

fact.en: It belongs to the imidazopyrimidine family, which is chemically unlike the benzodiazepines but acts at the same site on the GABA-A receptor, much as zolpidem does.
fact.zh: 它屬於咪唑并嘧啶家族，化學結構與苯二氮平類不同，卻作用於GABA-A受體上的相同位點，與佐沛眠的情形類似。
fact.zhHans: 它属于咪唑并嘧啶家族，化学结构与苯二氮平类不同，却作用于GABA-A受体上的相同位点，与佐沛眠的情形类似。
